desktop_feature_thread_spawn.reason: The cancellation unit test uses a temporary waiter thread and joins it before returning.
The GPUI shutdown responsiveness test uses a watchdog thread and joins it before returning.

desktop_thread_builder.reason: BlockingJobScheduler owns and joins its bounded worker pool.
The one-shot i18n preload worker is joined before preload_i18n returns.
The central named-thread factory returns join handles to explicit lifecycle owners.
CredentialAutofillMatchPipeline owns, stops, and joins its matcher worker.
SessionEventBridge owns, signals, and joins its bridge worker.
TerminalFramePipeline owns, closes, and joins its frame worker.
Windows keyboard capture owns the hook thread, posts WM_QUIT, unhooks, and joins it.
The ignored root-render benchmark joins its large-stack test thread.
The workspace stack-regression test uses a named one-MiB-stack thread and joins it before returning.
The prompt broker test joins its named request thread.
SshConnectionPool owns its process-wide disconnect worker and DisconnectWorker joins it during shutdown.
Per-session X/YMODEM state owns, stops, and joins its upload worker.

raw_scroll_container.reason: Batch draft owns the body ScrollHandle; in-flow body tracks it and the non-scrolling parent attaches vertical_scrollbar outside the selector and footer.

Session information keeps its ScrollHandle in SessionFeatureState for close/reopen reset, tracks it on the in-flow body, and attaches vertical_scrollbar to the non-scrolling parent outside the header and footer.
File manager table tracks a caller-owned horizontal ScrollHandle and attaches NyaHorizontalScrollbar to the non-scrolling viewport alongside its independent virtual-list scrollbar.
AI mention, model, and history lists use caller-owned ScrollHandles for keyboard reveal and attach visible vertical scrollbars to those handles.
Asset table uses a caller-owned horizontal scroll handle with an explicit NyaHorizontalScrollbar overlay.
Session tabs use a caller-owned scroll handle and attach a visible horizontal scrollbar to the non-scrolling parent.

Connection editor content tracks its caller-owned ScrollHandle for section anchors and keyboard reveal; connection_editor_frame in connection/layout.rs attaches vertical_scrollbar to the non-scrolling parent.
The model-row layout fixture tracks a caller-owned ScrollHandle to verify scrolling and attaches vertical_scrollbar to the non-scrolling parent.
Browser uses a caller-owned horizontal scrollbar.
Transfer path menu uses a caller-owned ScrollHandle and attaches an explicit vertical scrollbar to the scrolling child.
Settings content tracks an explicit scroll handle and attaches a visible vertical scrollbar to the non-scrolling parent.
Reusable widgets own caller-positioned scrollbar overlays.
